tasks.subject: Task 2: Server `[tiles]` config and the disk cache
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A node reads `[tiles]` and keeps map pieces in a size-capped LRU disk cache that refuses bad pieces.

Full steps: superpowers/plans/2026-11-26-m11-location-sharing.md (Task 2: Server `[tiles]` config and the disk cache).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m11/internal/config/config.go", "otter-server-m11/internal/config/tiles_test.go", "otter-server-m11/internal/tiles/validate.go"], "verifyCommand": "`cd otter-server-m11 && nice -n 15 go test -p 4 -count=1 ./internal/config/ ./internal/tiles/` → `ok`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["No `[tiles]` section → `CacheMB = 2048`, `Upstream = \"\"`.", "`upstream` must be `https://` (or `http://127.0.0.1…` only in tests via the `allowPlain` test hook); `cache_mb` 64…1048576.", "`Valid(z,x,y)` rejects `z > 14` and `x, y ≥ 2^z`; `Check(data)` rejects empty, > 1 MiB, broken gzip, gzip > 8 MiB.", "Cache: `Put` then `Get` returns the bytes; total bytes stay ≤ cap after many `Put`s (least recently used removed first); a restart rebuilds the index from disk; files written atomically (tmp + rename)."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Server HTTPS upstream fetcher
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A node with `upstream` fetches missing pieces once each, bounded in size, time and rate.

Full steps: superpowers/plans/2026-11-26-m11-location-sharing.md (Task 3: Server HTTPS upstream fetcher).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m11/internal/tiles/upstream.go"], "verifyCommand": "`nice -n 15 go test -p 4 -count=1 ./internal/tiles/ -run Upstream` → `ok`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["A TileJSON URL is resolved to `tiles[0]` (re-resolved after 24 h or after a 404 burst); a URL containing `{z}` is used as a template directly.", "200 → bytes (after `Check`); 404/204 → `ErrMissing`; other status, timeout, > 1 MiB → error.", "10 concurrent `Fetch` of the same piece → 1 upstream request (singleflight).", "More than 20 fetches/s per node → `ErrBusy` without contacting upstream."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Peer tile frames
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A node asks its peers for a piece; a peer answers from its cache or own upstream only, and a hostile peer cannot hurt the asker.

Full steps: superpowers/plans/2026-11-26-m11-location-sharing.md (Task 4: Peer tile frames).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m11/internal/replication/tiles.go", "otter-server-m11/internal/replication/session.go"], "verifyCommand": "`nice -n 15 go test -p 4 -count=1 ./internal/replication/ -run Tile` → `ok`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`Replicator.FetchTile(ctx, z, x, y)` tries peers in order (last good peer first), 10 s per peer, returns the first piece that passes `tiles.Check`; all missing → `tiles.ErrMissing`.", "Serving side uses `TileSource.Local(ctx, z,x,y)` (cache, then own upstream) — never `FetchTile` (no loops); invalid z/x/y → `missing`; busy (`serveSem` full) → `missing` at once.", "A hostile peer answering with > 1 MiB, broken gzip, or an unknown `req` does not crash the session, nothing is cached, and the next peer is tried."]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: `tiles.get` for phones, metrics, wiring
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Logged-in members get map pieces from cache → upstream → peers, limited to 600 per minute.

Full steps: superpowers/plans/2026-11-26-m11-location-sharing.md (Task 5: `tiles.get` for phones, metrics, wiring).

```json:metadata
{"files": ["otter-server-m11/internal/service/tiles.go", "internal/gateway/tiles_test.go", "internal/service/service.go", "internal/gateway/methods.go", "internal/metrics/metrics.go"], "verifyCommand": "`nice -n 15 go test -p 4 -count=1 ./internal/service/ ./internal/gateway/ ./internal/metrics/ ./cmd/otter-node/ -run 'Tile|Metrics|Status'` → `ok`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Order: cache hit → `upstream.Fetch` (if configured) → `Fetcher.FetchTile` (peers) — but **only if no upstream is configured** — → `ErrNotFound`. Successful fetches are cached.", "`TileSource.Local` (for peers) = cache → upstream, never peers.", "Not logged in → `UNAUTHORIZED`; revoked → `REVOKED`; z > 14 → `INVALID`; 601st in a minute → `QUOTA`; no source configured and no peers → `NOT_FOUND`.", "A node without upstream never contacts the upstream test server (hit counter stays 0).", "`Snapshot` gains `tiles_served`, `tiles_cache_hits`, `tiles_upstream`, `tiles_peer`, `tiles_cache_bytes`; `Line()` adds `tiles=<served>/<hits>`; Prometheus `otter_tiles_*`."]}
```
